items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: I think Dr. Sherry was down here somewhere on Claiborne Street.

ctx.x: I think Dr. Sherry was down here somewhere on Claiborne Street. I see. It's funny, I can't remember who Yalla would be or whenever I asked you. Oh no, I think that was long before your time. Yeah. Yeah, that was long before your time. When you played with Herb Moran, who did you play with the band? Well, I was Herb, Walter Nelson.
And we had one of Lauren's other cousins. who played piano.
